Their second studio album, "American Tragedy", was released April 5, 2011.  All of the band members use pseudonyms and wear their own unique mask, most of which are based on the common hockey goaltender design. Desperate Measures (Hollywood Undead album) | Desperate Measures is the second CD/DVD box set by American rock band Hollywood Undead.  The album was released on November 10, 2009 through A&M Records and Octone Records.  The album includes three new songs, three cover songs, a remix of "Everywhere I Go", and six live versions of previously released tracks from a concert in Albuquerque, New Mexico along with a 60-minute DVD of live performances.  The album debuted at No. 29 on the "Billboard" 200, No. 10 on Top Rock Albums, and No. 15 on Top Digital Albums.
